local Part = script.Parent
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- remember what the part looked like before anyone touches it
local OriginalSize = Part.Size
local OriginalCFrame = Part.CFrame

local Pressed = false
local Touches = 0 -- how many humanoids are currently standing on it

local PressSound = Instance.new("Sound")
PressSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://116062165012558"
PressSound.Volume = 0.5
PressSound.Parent = Part

local ReleaseSound = Instance.new("Sound")
ReleaseSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://133222321566847"
ReleaseSound.Volume = 0.5
ReleaseSound.Parent = Part

local function Press()
	if Pressed then return end
	Pressed = true

	-- stop the release sound in case it's still finishing up, then play press once
	ReleaseSound:Stop()
	PressSound:Stop()
	PressSound:Play()

	-- squish the plate down
	TweenService:Create(Part, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = Vector3.new(OriginalSize.X * 1.12, OriginalSize.Y * 0.25, OriginalSize.Z * 1.12),
		CFrame = OriginalCFrame * CFrame.new(0, -OriginalSize.Y * 0.4, 0)
	}):Play()
end

local function Release()
	if not Pressed then return end
	Pressed = false

	-- stop the press sound in case it's still finishing up, then play release once
	PressSound:Stop()
	ReleaseSound:Stop()
	ReleaseSound:Play()

	-- pop back to normal with a bit of bounce
	TweenService:Create(Part, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = OriginalSize,
		CFrame = OriginalCFrame
	}):Play()
end

Part.Touched:Connect(function(Hit)
	local Character = Hit.Parent
	if not Character then return end

	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not Humanoid then return end

	Touches += 1
	Press()
end)

Part.TouchEnded:Connect(function(Hit)
	local Character = Hit.Parent
	if not Character then return end

	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not Humanoid then return end

	Touches -= 1
	if Touches < 0 then
		Touches = 0 -- just in case touch events get a little out of sync
	end

	if Touches == 0 then
		Release()
	end
end)"},{"path":"Workspace.Butter.Camera","attributes":[],"class":"Camera"}],"textureId":"rbxassetid://104473509395618"}
